entry.title: chore: cut FastAPI and Neo4j, promote app, land Anki ingest (#282)
entry.content:
chore: cut FastAPI and Neo4j, promote app, land Anki ingest (#282)

* chore: cut retired FastAPI and Neo4j, land Anki ingest

The TDD already retired the second service. Deleting it also retires
the Dependabot tree that existed only to bump it. The parser reads
the real exports to 457 records.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* docs: fold host troubleshooting and docs index into the overhaul

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* chore: pin Node 22, cut leftover scaffold, land the systems diagram

isomorphic-dompurify 4.2.0 refuses Node 20, which is why Actions died at
install. The README now shows built vs planned. OVERHAUL.md was a PR brief.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* fix(ingest): scope node ids to the owner, sanitize through the parser

Review findings on PR 282.

Blocking: sanitize.test.ts fed the raw CompSci export to sanitizeCardHtml.
Anki writes RFC4180, so an internal quote is doubled on disk and the attribute
reached the sanitizer as href=""https://...""; that parses as an empty href and
the scheme guard correctly stripped it. The test was wrong about its own input,
not the sanitizer. It now parses first and asserts on the parsed fields, which
is the only input the sanitizer ever sees. 46 of 46 pass, was 43 of 44.

Major: internalId digested the Anki GUID alone while nodes.id is a global text
primary key. Anki GUIDs propagate through shared decks, so the second user to
import one would collide with the first on every overlapping card. Both digests
now carry the owner. Chosen over a composite primary key so the foreign keys in
edges, review_state, review_log, harvests and quest_runs stay single-column.
parseAnkiExport takes userId as a result.

Content-Security-Policy via kit.csp rather than vercel.json, because SvelteKit's
hydration payload is an inline script only the framework can nonce. Measured on
the dev SSR response: the header ships, the inline script carries a nonce, and
every script and link on the page is covered.

Also drops the identity /api rewrite in vercel.json and the redundant JSDoc
@type in hooks.server.ts.

Negative controls, worktree restored after each:
  internalId ignoring userId    -> the 2 tenancy assertions go red
  sanitizeCardHtml passthrough  -> 19 of 46 go red, the corpus test among them

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_016p7oRUDeobTUup9TvNEtqz

* chore: record the Dev Container cut, single-source deploys, clear cruft

Deprecate the Dev Container in the docs that outlive it. The files went in
the first pass; TDD 3.4 and 12.2 now say it stays gone and why, so a model
reading this tree does not rebuild it from a tutorial.

Cut the second deploy path. The Actions deploy job and the Vercel Git
integration both built every push. Actions now verifies only, and the
workflow is renamed to match. Root Directory is a dashboard setting and
still reads frontend, which is the one human step left.

Cruft: TROUBLESHOOTING.md (three of four items said start Docker Desktop),
.pre-commit-config.yaml (Python hook runner, no Python, eslint 9 against a
tree on 10), .envrc and .envrc.example (RUST_LOG, DOMAIN_NAME, unread),
src/lib/index.ts, the red scaffold client test harness and the deps it
orphaned, and source_data/ArticleMetadata.csv (byte-identical to
articles.csv).

yarn test:server 46 of 46. yarn lint and yarn check green on Node 22.23.1.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: record the measured Vercel project settings

Read project prj_RnBD1bE2cYV61qnpATWrMV0qUnJI on 2026-09-16. Node.js is
already 22.x and the preset is already SvelteKit, so the pending "set
Node.js to 22" step was stale. Root Directory reading frontend is the only
blocker, and the build log shows it aborting 0.6s after clone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(verify): build the app in Actions

Actions ran lint, typecheck and tests but never built. The only proof the
app compiled came from the Vercel Git integration, so a project-settings
fault and a genuine build break were indistinguishable from this repo.

Verified on Node 22 from a cleared .svelte-kit: lint, check at 637 files /
0 errors, 46 of 46 tests, and a full adapter-vercel build emitting
.vercel/output with functions and static.

entry.title: chore(ai): drop the claugmentations sync workflow and vendored skills…
entry.content:
chore(ai): drop the claugmentations sync workflow and vendored skills (#277)

The vendoring design is gone upstream. claugmentations now installs once into a user's home directory, so the shared skills load in every repo without being committed to any of them; there is nothing here left to sync or check.

The 'claugmentations / check' job was failing on every open PR. Two reasons compounded: 'claugmentations check' no longer means 'is this repo in sync' -- it verifies an install root, which does not exist on a runner -- and Dependabot PRs receive no secrets, so CLAUGMENTATIONS_TOKEN was empty and the package checkout could not authenticate either.

Unlike cooperability.com, nothing under .claude/ or .cursor/ in this repo was ever project-local: both trees held only the 13 vendored skills and a README describing the sync. They are removed whole, along with .claugmentations.json and the workflow. deploy.yml is untouched.

entry.title: chore(ai): update shared skills to claugmentations v0.2.0 (#268)
entry.content:
chore(ai): update shared skills to claugmentations v0.2.0 (#268)

Brings this repo to the thirteen-skill set and wires the sync workflow so it
cannot silently fall behind again.

New: shepherd-to-pr (one-shot scoped idea to graded draft PR), plan-feature,
verified-change-loop, git-hygiene, extract-chat-insights.

sanitize-pr-for-merge and rebase-squash-before-merge are replaced by
premerge-cleanup, which consolidates them. Both carried a latent bug: squashing
via `git reset --soft origin/main` is safe only on a freshly rebased branch, and
on a diverged one it stages the inverse of every base commit the branch lacks —
committing that silently reverts other people's work. The replacement resets to
the merge-base and verifies the diffstat is unchanged afterwards.

.github/workflows/claugmentations-sync.yml fails a PR that edits a synced skill
in place, and weekly opens a draft PR when upstream moves. It authenticates with
CLAUGMENTATIONS_TOKEN, a fine-grained PAT scoped to read only the claugmentations
repo, and deliberately omits --force so a bot can never overwrite a local edit.

The skills remain stack-agnostic, so they apply to this Python/Docker/GraphQL
repo unchanged. Anything needing a concrete build or test command stays local.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.content:

Adds the nine stack-agnostic git/GitHub workflow skills from the
claugmentations package, mirrored for Claude Code and Cursor.

These are portable by construction — they describe git, gh, and review
workflows with no toolchain assumptions, so they apply to this Python/Docker
stack unchanged. Anything needing a concrete build or test command stays local
to this repo instead.

.claugmentations.json records what is managed; the sync touches nothing else
